message.reasoning_content: The claim: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin co-wrote the 2017 Transformer paper "Attention Is All You Need". Evidence lists authors including Illia Polosukhin. This matches well-established knowledge: the paper's authors are Vaswani, Shazeer, Parmar, Uszkoreit, Jones, Gomez, Kaiser, Polosukhin. Illia Polosukhin is indeed a co-founder of NEAR Protocol. So verdict FACT.
